patthana18.12:1.1: Hetuñceva sahetukaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu ceva naahetuko ca nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṃkhittaṃ.) Hetuyā ekaṃ…pe… avigate ekaṃ.
patthana18.12:2.1: Sahetukañceva na ca hetuṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naahetuko ceva nana ca hetu nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṃkhittaṃ.) Hetuyā ekaṃ…pe… avigate ekaṃ.
